adjudicated_statement: In the C66-GEO-COMP approach for (g,n)=(6,6), an existence clause asserting that a concrete degree-four cover satisfies the Casnati-Ekedahl structure-theorem hypotheses (CE) and the normalization condition (N) cannot establish balancedness of the associated CE/Tschirnhausen data by invoking a balancedness criterion whose own derivation already assumes (CE)+(N), unless the CE embedding, its resolution, and the normalization are independently constructed within the attempt or supplied by a verified dependency artifact. The obstruction is conditional and methodological: it does not assert that the genus-two double-cover example of ATT-0100 is not balanced, only that this argument pattern is circular and leaves balancedness undischarged. As of revision 2, ATT-0100 supplies no such independent construction or verified dependency for its genus-two double-cover example; this attempt-level clause rests on the single codex adversarial review REV-0149 and requires confirmation by a non-excluded engine before the finding may be promoted.
contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the statement is a methodological circularity obstruction that does not oppose any cross-checked claim; it is compatible with the campaign's dependency-closure discipline. Local provenance: the finding rests on ATT-0100 and REV-0149 (revision-2 adversarial review, reviewer engine codex). Both artifacts were listed in the workspace but could not be opened before the read budget was exhausted, and codex is an excluded engine for this campaign revision, so the factual clause 'ATT-0100 does not discharge this requirement for its genus-two double-cover example' currently has only single-engine adversarial support and has not been independently confirmed by this audit. The visible portion of proof/findings.jsonl (FND-0001 through FND-0034) contains no finding addressing Casnati-Ekedahl balancedness circularity, so no merge target was identified; the full findings list beyond the truncated read could not be scanned. Live-web limitation: the native web-evidence stage was bounded and unavailable and no Grok worker was dispatched, so no public source was actually fetched; the single source_record cites the genuine primary reference for the degree-four CE structure theorem (Casnati-Ekedahl, Invent. Math. 125 (1996) 607-637, DOI 10.1007/s002220050089) whose (CE)+(N) framework the finding concerns, but its content_sha256 is an all-zero sentinel marking 'not fetched in this audit' rather than a computed digest. Because the attempt-level factual component is unverified here and the supporting review comes from an excluded engine, the finding is retained as candidate rather than promoted; the general circularity principle is sound, but promotion requires an independent inspection of ATT-0100/REV-0149 (or a non-excluded-engine replication) and, ideally, a fetched primary-source digest.
